newsitem.title: UK: Bradstock says markets remain difficult.
newsitem.headline: Bradstock says markets remain difficult.

text.p: British insurance and reinsurance broker Bradstock Group Plc on Thursday reported a 13 percent rise in full year pre-tax profits and said it was confident about the future and in a good competitive position.
But the company said market conditions continued to be difficult.
Profits before exceptionals in the year to September 30 rose to 6.9 million stg. The dividend was unchanged at 5.7 pence per share.

Commenting on the results, Bradstock chairman Eddie McGrath said: "This robust performance reflects practical steps taken by the group's management in recent years to insulate Bradstock from some of the worst effects of changes in the insurance industry."
Those measures include expanding specialist broking operations, increasing exposure to the fast-growing Asian markets and cutting costs.
